{{Top|leg}}
A '''power pack recharger''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. It was a interface to the internal [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] which allowed the weapon to be recharged from an external source. The power pack had to be partially removed from the blaster to allow a cable to be plugged into the socket located on the end of the pack.
